tools.name: vadyu_list_sequences_and_formats

tools.name: vadyu_expand_video_funnel
tools.description: One-call 0-credit 3-stage TOF/MOF/BOF funnel expansion for any completed Vadyu video (`status === 'done'`). Reuses the source video's verified 5s AI motion clip across all 3 vertical funnel recipes (`ai_renders_reserved: 0`, 0 AI render credits charged).

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: vadyu_get_video_status · Public sink: vadyu_submit_recipe_feedback, vadyu_get_video_status.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: vadyu_get_video_status · Public sink: vadyu_submit_recipe_feedback, vadyu_get_video_status

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
